rules.title: How Incursions work
rules.tokens: You start with {{start}} run tokens and hold up to {{max}}; one more arrives every {{hours}} hours. Starting a run costs {{cost}}.
rules.team: Only heroes from the MoW's allowed factions can join; bring at least {{count}}.
rules.progress: Each tier is a run map: battles, enhancement picks and chests. Once you pick a branch, the others close for that run.
rules.replay: Tiers can be played in any order. Damage your heroes take carries over from battle to battle and only resets when the run ends. A cleared tier can be replayed: 3-star battles can be raided, star rewards are paid only once, and chests pay out every run.

summary.bestPathMythic: Up to {{shards}} shards and {{mythicShards}} mythic shards per clear
summary.bestPathHint: MoW shards from 3-star wins and chests along the richest path through this tier.

progress.remaining: {{shards}} shards left to earn from battle stars
progress.remainingMythic: {{shards}} shards and {{mythicShards}} mythic shards left to earn from battle stars
progress.howTo: Open a tier to set the stars you've earned on each battle, or mark the whole tier at 3 stars. A tier counts as cleared once you've won a battle on its last step.
progress.raidableHint: Cleared with 3 stars, so later runs can raid it.
progress.replayHint: You've cleared this tier, so replays pay only its chests; star rewards are paid once.
progress.tierOneTime: {{shards}} one-time shards left in this tier
progress.tierOneTimeMythic: {{shards}} shards and {{mythicShards}} mythic shards left in this tier, one time only
progress.signIn: Sign in to save the stars you've earned on each battle.
progress.conflict: Incursion progress changed elsewhere. Latest values loaded; apply your change again.
progress.saveError: Couldn't save Incursion progress. Your changes are still here; try again.

leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.description: Your Incursion progress changes haven't been saved and will be lost.

team.title: Suggested team
team.sustainHint: Damage carries over between battles, so a Healer (or a Mechanic with a Mechanical ally) is swapped in for the weakest member when the strongest heroes have none.
team.hint: From your synced roster: the strongest heroes of the allowed factions, with a Healer swapped in. Each tier caps heroes to its rarity, so its estimate uses the capped team. Enemy power is coloured for that team: green is comfortable, amber is winnable at full HP, red is out of reach.
team.tooFew_one: You need at least {{count}} hero from the allowed factions.
team.tooFew_other: You need at least {{count}} heroes from the allowed factions.
team.unsynced: Sync your roster to see a suggested team and which tiers it can clear.
team.noPower: Power estimates are unavailable right now.

tier.markHint: Sets every battle in this tier at once. Save to keep the change.
tier.markTier: Mark every battle of {{tier}} at 3 stars

power.enemy: Enemy power: every enemy's power added up
power.vsTeam: Enemy power: {{ratio}}× your team's power at this tier

rewards.all: All rewards for finishing this tier
rewards.hint: Chests pay every run; star rewards you haven't earned yet are paid once.

eligible.title: Heroes for {{mow}}
eligible.hint: Every hero of the allowed factions, strongest first. Tap heroes to try a team of up to 5; nothing is saved.

estimate.firstRun: First run wins {{wins}} of {{battles}} battles with your team capped to this tier ({{power}} power).
estimate.hint: Estimate: your suggested team with every hero capped to this tier's rarity ({{power}} power). A battle is won while your power × HP left reaches a fifth of the enemy power; each win costs HP in proportion (less with a Healer). Battles won stay won, so the next run starts at full HP where the last one stopped.
